[[Grawl Petitioner (monk)|Grawl Petitioners]] are a variety of [[Grawl]] found in [[Regent Valley]].

==Locations==
*[[Ascalon]]
**{{NPC location|Regent Valley}}

==Skills==
*{{skill icon|Heal Area}}
*{{skill icon|Heal Other}}
*{{skill icon|Healing Hands}} ([[elite]]; Hard Mode only)

==Items dropped==
*[[Grawl Shaman Gear]]
*[[Ornate Grawl Necklace]]

==Notes==
* Grawl Petitioners do not appear to be allied to [[Grawl Heretic]]s, this could indicate an unexplained civil or religious conflict among the Grawl.
* A group of Grawl Petitioners including some [[Grawl Petitioner (warrior)]]s sometimes appear southwest of Fort Ranik and travels through the tar until they reach the ruined statue of [[Melandru]] near [[King's Watch]], where a [[Grawl High Priest]] awaits. If left alone, they will perform actions that seem to emulate praying.
